requirementsVi: Phản đối việc áp dụng một cách cứng nhắc cho tất cả.
Giải thích trở ngại và khác biệt hoàn cảnh.
Thừa nhận lợi ích và đề xuất cách linh hoạt hơn.
samples.summaryVi: Theo dõi chi tiêu giúp thấy nhu cầu thiết yếu; kế hoạch phải có khoảng linh hoạt cho việc phát sinh.

paragraphs.label: Mở bài
paragraphs.text: It is sometimes suggested that everyone should follow one standard approach to planning everyday spending, regardless of their needs. I disagree with this view. A shared goal can be useful, but an identical rule may ignore the practical conditions that determine whether people can benefit from it.
paragraphs.noteVi: Phản đối sự cứng nhắc, không phủ nhận toàn bộ chủ đề.

paragraphs.label: Lý do 1 — điều kiện khác nhau
paragraphs.text: A difficulty that should not be ignored is that a strict plan can fail when unexpected costs appear. This matters because real life includes repairs, travel changes and other expenses that are hard to predict. For instance, someone may abandon a whole spending plan after paying for an urgent bicycle repair. The result may be frustration or a decision to stop taking part. This is not simply a question of people refusing to make an effort; practical conditions can prevent a reasonable idea from working as intended.
paragraphs.noteVi: Theo dõi chi tiêu giúp thấy nhu cầu thiết yếu; kế hoạch phải có khoảng linh hoạt cho việc phát sinh.

paragraphs.label: Lý do 2 — nguyên nhân cần xử lý
paragraphs.text: One reason for the difficulty is that people may create budgets with no allowance for change. This can help explain why a strict plan can fail when unexpected costs appear. Consider the following situation: someone may abandon a whole spending plan after paying for an urgent bicycle repair. It shows that the problem is connected with the way the activity is organised, not only with an individual's attitude. Unless that underlying condition changes, asking people to try harder may have little effect.
paragraphs.noteVi: Giải thích vì sao yêu cầu cố gắng hơn chưa đủ.

paragraphs.label: Thừa nhận và hướng khác
paragraphs.text: This does not mean that the original idea has no value. For example, a student can compare spending on transport, food and online orders before deciding where to cut back. The possibility that people can see whether their income covers essential needs is worth taking seriously. However, a better approach would be to use a flexible plan and review it regularly. A learner could separate essential costs from optional purchases and leave a small amount for unexpected needs.
paragraphs.noteVi: Thừa nhận điểm mạnh và đưa giải pháp có điều kiện.

paragraphs.label: Kết bài
paragraphs.text: In conclusion, I do not support requiring one method for everyone. A workable policy should keep its main purpose while allowing practical adjustments. This is more likely to help people participate than a rigid rule that treats different circumstances as if they were the same.
paragraphs.noteVi: Chốt đúng đối tượng phản đối: một phương pháp cho mọi người.

samples.title: Dành thời gian cho sở thích
samples.prompt: A single standard approach to making time for hobbies should be required for everyone, regardless of their needs. Do you agree or disagree?
requirementsVi: Phản đối việc áp dụng một cách cứng nhắc cho tất cả.
Giải thích trở ngại và khác biệt hoàn cảnh.
Thừa nhận lợi ích và đề xuất cách linh hoạt hơn.
samples.summaryVi: Sở thích giúp đổi nhịp sống; nên bắt đầu nhỏ, vừa túi tiền và không so mình với người đã giỏi.

paragraphs.label: Mở bài
paragraphs.text: It is sometimes suggested that everyone should follow one standard approach to making time for hobbies, regardless of their needs. I disagree with this view. A shared goal can be useful, but an identical rule may ignore the practical conditions that determine whether people can benefit from it.
paragraphs.noteVi: Phản đối sự cứng nhắc, không phủ nhận toàn bộ chủ đề.

paragraphs.label: Lý do 1 — điều kiện khác nhau
paragraphs.text: A difficulty that should not be ignored is that an ambitious hobby plan can become another source of pressure. This matters because expensive equipment and demanding goals may make a beginner feel unsuccessful. For instance, someone may stop practising music after trying to learn several difficult pieces in the first week. The result may be frustration or a decision to stop taking part. This is not simply a question of people refusing to make an effort; practical conditions can prevent a reasonable idea from working as intended.
paragraphs.noteVi: Sở thích giúp đổi nhịp sống; nên bắt đầu nhỏ, vừa túi tiền và không so mình với người đã giỏi.

paragraphs.label: Lý do 2 — nguyên nhân cần xử lý
paragraphs.text: One reason for the difficulty is that people may compare their starting point with experienced hobbyists. This can help explain why an ambitious hobby plan can become another source of pressure. Consider the following situation: someone may stop practising music after trying to learn several difficult pieces in the first week. It shows that the problem is connected with the way the activity is organised, not only with an individual's attitude. Unless that underlying condition changes, asking people to try harder may have little effect.
paragraphs.noteVi: Giải thích vì sao yêu cầu cố gắng hơn chưa đủ.

paragraphs.label: Thừa nhận và hướng khác
paragraphs.text: This does not mean that the original idea has no value. For example, an office worker can spend one evening each week learning to draw with a small local group. The possibility that a hobby can provide a break from work and routine responsibilities is worth taking seriously. However, a better approach would be to begin with small goals and choose an affordable way to practise. A beginner could borrow equipment and practise one simple skill for a short time each week.
paragraphs.noteVi: Thừa nhận điểm mạnh và đưa giải pháp có điều kiện.

paragraphs.label: Kết bài
paragraphs.text: In conclusion, I do not support requiring one method for everyone. A workable policy should keep its main purpose while allowing practical adjustments. This is more likely to help people participate than a rigid rule that treats different circumstances as if they were the same.
paragraphs.noteVi: Chốt đúng đối tượng phản đối: một phương pháp cho mọi người.
